issues.reason: The startup validator accepts the manifest field; the closed engine runtime schema omits it.
The effective startup default comes from the manifest, which differs from the engine schema.
The default namespace is emitted as null. Preserve null in serialized recall results.
The startup walker ignores propertyNames. Preserve accepted model-map keys while validating their values; the generated type projection omits this constraint.

The startup walker measures minLength and maxLength in UTF-16 code units. Rust performs that check explicitly and removes scalar-count lengths from the compiled compatibility validator and generated projection.

Node Number.isInteger accepts integral JSON numbers such as 1.0. The schema walker checks their numeric value; the generated config projection uses lossless JSON numbers after validation and omits numeric restrictions already checked at the boundary.
Uncapped closed, warm, aborted and other early exits return Infinity in Node; JSON serializes it as null. Preserve null as the uncapped sentinel.
